datasheet_identity.title: MMSZ4678 THRU MMSZ4717 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES (SOD-123 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes)

extraction_notes: The MMSZ4691 row gives VZ min/nom/max = 5.89/6.2/6.51 V at IZT = 50 microA; IR maximum 10 microA at VR = 5.0 V (p. 2).
The supplied p. 3 plots are power-derating and transient-thermal-impedance curves only; no usable electrical zener, forward-IV, capacitance, or reverse-current curve is provided for MMSZ4691.
No per-part capacitance or reverse-recovery time is published.
extraction.omission_reason: No usable MMSZ4691 electrical curve is published: the datasheet contains only power-derating and transient-thermal-impedance plots on p. 3, with no part-specific electrical curve.
